text: あーあ　わたしの　かれ　きょうも　いそがしいん　だって！

structure.jp: わたしの　かれ　きょうも　いそがしいん　だって！
structure.en: my boyfriend says he's busy again today!

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: いそがしいん　だって
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which wraps up what someone said. At the end of a sentence it means 'he says' or 'I hear'. いそがしいん　だって = 'he says he's busy'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ gives the feeling of explaining, here as part of the boyfriend's own excuse. んだ is the spoken form. いそがしいん　だ = 'it's that I'm busy'.
